decisions.statement: An empty set of people is an error rather than a household of nobody.
People come back sorted by slug.
A person page that will not load raises an error naming the file.
A person page stating no slug raises an error rather than an unnamed person.
A slug naming no person reads as null.
The persona answering for a person reads back as her slug alone.
A person required by slug where none answers is an error.

definition: person pages read back as who someone is, one by slug or all of them sorted
